That is the same job as wrapAngle (src/sim/vec.ts:10-16, 'Wraps an angle into (−π, π]'). Both helpers are exported, and src/sim/track.ts:11 already imports headingOf from vec.ts. Both are new lines in this branch's new test file, so changing them is allowed.
results.reason: The new test re-implements headingOf and wrapAngle, which already exist in src/sim/vec.ts and do the same thing. Swapping in the imports doesn't change behaviour.

results.trace: Ran `pnpm vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/verify/R4-1.test.ts`. The test takes the hay-bale props of trackLayout(getTrack('hay-loop')) with x > 200 (the hairpin inside row: from 0.41 to 0.475, spacing 4, offset 2). It builds each as an oriented HAY_BALE_LENGTH×HAY_BALE_WIDTH (2×1.2) box and checks every pair for intersection with a separating-axis test. It fails with 6 intersecting pairs, e.g. bales 6 (259.7,9.1) and 7 (260.3,9.0) with centres 0.64 apart, 16 and 17 with centres 0.46 apart, and 11 and 12 1.41 apart. Bales spaced 4 units on the centreline land under 2 units apart on the 7.5-unit inside offset round the tip.
results.reason: The hairpin's inside bale colliders really do intersect, so the bales overlap visually. The test passes once the row's offset or extent is changed so that no two boxes intersect.
